Container.Name: isputnik-video
Container.Overview:
The video engine for isputnik.home: TV shows and movies, scanned from your video folders, described from .nfo files and played in the browser. Alpha.
This container has no sign-in and no web address of its own. The isputnik.home container reaches it by name over a shared Docker network; video libraries are created, shared and watched in isputnik.home. Set up: put both containers on one user-defined Docker network (docker network create isputnik); set the isputnik container's Video URL (VIDEO_URL) to http://isputnik-video:4300 and restart it; in isputnik.home open Control panel, Apps, Setup, choose Video, press Generate secret and paste it here as Gateway Secret. Then add a library under Control panel, Library, Libraries, Add library, Video.

Config.Name: Config & Data
Config.Description: Stores the catalog: shows, seasons, episodes and movies found in the video folders (a SQLite database). Keep it apart from the isputnik container's appdata.

Config.Name: Video Folders
Config.Description: The share that holds your shows and movies, mounted read-only: the engine never writes to it. Each video library is a folder under it, for example Shows or Movies, chosen in isputnik.home when the library is added.

Config.Name: Transcode
Config.Description: Optional. Where a video is converted while someone watches it (a few hundred MB per viewer, deleted as they go). Point it at RAM (/tmp/isputnik-video) or a cache-pool folder to keep it off the array; left empty, it stays inside the container.

Config.Name: Gateway Secret
Config.Description: The secret made in isputnik.home under Control panel, Apps, Setup, Video (Generate secret, then Copy), or a long random string of at least 32 characters (openssl rand -hex 32) also set on the isputnik container as VIDEO_GATEWAY_SECRET. Every request the home app forwards carries it, which is how this server knows who is signed in. Required: the server refuses to start without it, or with a short one.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the server runs as. It runs unprivileged (not root); on first start it takes ownership of the Config & Data path as this user. This user must be able to read the Video Folders. 99 (nobody) matches the default owner of an Unraid share.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the server runs as. 100 (users) matches the default group of an Unraid share.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal or silent. The isputnik container shows this log under Control panel, Apps, Logs.
